title: Neighborhood clock directory | Describing repair services accurately
titleZh: 社區鐘錶指南｜如何準確說明維修服務
passage:
From: Tari, neighborhood clock directory volunteer
To: Welcome desk team
Subject: Two examples for the repair guide

An intake shop may book a job and take payment without doing the work. Name that shop as the intake contact, but attribute each repair to the workshop that performed it. A workshop’s message is enough to say what it reports having done. Do not describe a result as verified unless the owner has actually checked that result after getting the clock back.

Jun paid Oak Gate when leaving a clock whose chime was unreliable. Oak Gate forwarded it to Finch Bell. Finch Bell’s message says it adjusted the chime and noted that a separate timekeeping problem might need a later visit. At home, Jun heard it chime on the hour twice. Jun has not yet checked whether the clock keeps time correctly over an entire day.

When a visitor only wants to know what an inspection will cost, include every charge the visitor must pay to get the inspection under their circumstances. Do not reduce that figure by a credit that applies only if the visitor decides to have a repair. A visitor who takes the clock home unrepaired will not receive that credit.

Mira wants an inspection before deciding whether to repair her wall clock, and she needs the shop to pick it up. Oak Gate quotes 35 dollars for the inspection and 12 dollars to pick it up. Finch Bell quotes 44 dollars including pickup and will credit 10 dollars toward a repair if she orders one. Neither shop charges separately for returning the clock.
passageZh:
寄件人：社區鐘錶指南志工塔莉
收件人：服務台團隊
主旨：維修指南的兩個例子

受理店家可能負責安排維修和收款，但不一定親自維修。請把該店列為受理窗口，各項維修則要歸於實際執行的工作室。工作室的留言可以作為它回報做過哪些作業的依據，但直到物主取回時鐘並親自檢查那項結果，才能說該結果已獲確認。

俊把報時不穩的時鐘送去時，向橡門鐘錶行付款。橡門把時鐘送交雀鈴工作室。雀鈴留言說已調整報時裝置，也提到時鐘走時不準的另一個問題可能需要另約一次。俊在家兩次聽到時鐘準點報時，還沒檢查它是否一整天都走時準確。

如果來訪者只想知道檢查要花多少錢，請把他在目前情況下要做檢查必須支付的每筆費用都算進去。只有決定維修時才適用的折抵，不應從這筆費用中扣除。若檢查後不修、直接取回時鐘，就不會得到那筆折抵。

米拉想先做檢查，再決定是否修理家裡的掛鐘，且需要店家到府收件。橡門報價檢查費 35 元，另收 12 元到府收件費。雀鈴報價 44 元含到府收件；若米拉決定維修，則另折抵 10 元維修費。兩家都不另外收取送回時鐘的費用。
